calls.title: Ashley - PMM sync
calls.summary: The team discussed the imminent rollout of the Skills library and Visual Editor, emphasizing backend updates and community engagement. Graham is responsible for backend changes, while Elyse will confirm timing and logistics. Polished marketing materials, including high-quality videos and community demos, were prioritized to increase user engagement and clarity. The Growth Book 5.0 pricing rollout is tied to EU data center availability, necessitating clear messaging regarding new usage-based pricing. An early access program for the Visual Editor was proposed to gather user feedback and excitement. The need for professional video production was recognized, and ongoing documentation updates were deemed essential for consistent messaging.
